description: Maya is responsible for the family's backyard greenhouse for the coming growing season and must decide what to grow, how it will be watered, and who will care for it, with input from her cousin Theo and aunt Lina.

shared_context.S1: The family has one backyard greenhouse available for the coming growing season.
shared_context.S2: The greenhouse currently has no irrigation system, and its roof vent and shade cloth have not yet been set up.
shared_context.S3: Maya is coordinating the greenhouse plan and will make the final call on its use.
shared_context.S4: Before committing to a shared household project, the family has a habit of checking everyone's relevant resources, availability, and advice.
shared_context.S5: The family would like the greenhouse harvest to be useful rather than decorative.
shared_context.S6: The greenhouse care plan may use a limited recurring schedule because the watering system can be automated after installation; it does not require someone to be present every day.

PF1.text: Theo's neighbor Rosa has offered the family a free 60-gallon rain barrel, and Theo can install a drip line from it. Theo can also care for the greenhouse only on Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday evenings after 18:00.

PF2.text: Lina asked horticulturist Ben Alvarez to look at the greenhouse's light, and he recommended growing cherry tomatoes and basil, with the roof vent kept open and shade cloth used during strong afternoon sun; this recommendation has not reached the group yet.

acceptance_conditions: The greenhouse must be planted with cherry tomatoes and basil.
Watering must use the offered 60-gallon rain barrel and a drip line.
The roof vent must remain open and shade cloth must be used during strong afternoon sun.
Theo must be assigned responsibility for greenhouse care.
The care schedule must specify Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday evenings after 18:00.
The settlement must include a commitment to install the rain-barrel drip system.
The settlement must include a commitment to follow the horticulturist's recommendation for cherry tomatoes and basil.
Lina's horticulturist recommendation must be spoken aloud and cited as justification.

content_checks.C1: 'Cherry tomatoes' in decisions['crop_plan'] and 'basil' in decisions['crop_plan']
content_checks.C2: '60-gallon' in decisions['watering_method'] and 'rain barrel' in decisions['watering_method'] and 'drip line' in decisions['watering_method']
content_checks.C3: ('roof vent' in decisions['ventilation_and_sun_plan'] or 'Roof vent' in decisions['ventilation_and_sun_plan']) and 'open' in decisions['ventilation_and_sun_plan'] and ('shade cloth' in decisions['ventilation_and_sun_plan'] or 'Shade cloth' in decisions['ventilation_and_sun_plan']) and 'strong afternoon sun' in decisions['ventilation_and_sun_plan']
content_checks.C5: 'Tuesday' in decisions['care_schedule'] and 'Thursday' in decisions['care_schedule'] and 'Saturday' in decisions['care_schedule'] and ('18:00' in decisions['care_schedule'] or '6 PM' in decisions['care_schedule'] or '6pm' in decisions['care_schedule'])
content_checks.C6: any('drip line' in c['detail'] and 'rain barrel' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: ('Cherry tomatoes' in decisions['crop_plan'] or 'cherry tomatoes' in decisions['crop_plan']) and 'basil' in decisions['crop_plan'] and ('Ben Alvarez' in decisions['crop_plan'] or 'Ben Alvarez' in decisions['ventilation_and_sun_plan'])

decisive_facts.why: The free 60-gallon rain barrel and Theo's ability to install a drip line change the watering method and installation commitment, while his exact availability changes the caretaker assignment and schedule to Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday evenings after 18:00.

Ben Alvarez's specific recommendation changes the crop plan to cherry tomatoes and basil, changes ventilation to an open roof vent with shade cloth during strong afternoon sun, and supplies the exact crop details for the advice-followed decision.
